note: Differential cross section dσ/dQ² for single-pion production ν_μ p → μ⁻ π⁺ p at FNAL (15-foot hydrogen bubble chamber, E_ν > 5 GeV), for events with invariant hadronic mass M(π⁺p) < 1.4 GeV. Absolute published distribution in 10⁻³⁸ cm²/GeV² (Phys. Rev. Lett. 41 (1978) 1008). Integrating dσ/dQ² over the quoted bins gives 0.54×10⁻³⁸ cm², matching the paper's stated σ(M<1.4 GeV) = (0.55±0.08)×10⁻³⁸ cm², confirming this is the genuine absolute cross section (not a shape or event-count histogram). Target: free proton (hydrogen bubble chamber). Only this one absolute distribution ships in NUISANCE for the paper; the accompanying nEvent/_bin/_edit/_edges files are shape-fit intermediates and are excluded.
